content_text: I have reached a point where instead of starting research on a new name by exporting a couple hundred pages of sellside research into a single PDF and locking in with an iPad I simply go back and forth with ASKB asking nuanced questions with increased complexity and see where my curiosity takes me. Really wild how much more enjoyable and effective it has been vs forcing yourself through multiple initiations that often fail to ELI5 or completely skip basic facts that are necessary for understanding a company. And no I’m not saying stop doing the other things including sellside notes, expert networks, call transcripts etc. Still doesn’t proactively surface recent debates and the downside to the prompting-first approach is you’re blind to what is currently contentious. But still a superior way to start on a new name imho
